modAssist.disclaimer: **Suggestion only — you decide.** This is never automatically acted on.

config.keySet: API key saved (encrypted). Try `/ai config view` or the dashboard's "Test connection" button to verify it.
config.channelAdded: Added **#{channel}** to the allowed channels for /ask and /summarize.
config.budgetSet: Daily token budget set to **{daily}** (server) / **{perUser}** (per user).

errors.channelNotAllowed: This channel isn't on the AI assistant's allowed-channel list. An admin can add it with `/ai config channels add`.
errors.channelNotSummarizable: That's not a channel I can summarize (pick a text channel, announcement channel, or thread).
errors.messageContentIntentMissing: Summarizing needs the Message Content privileged intent, which isn't enabled for this bot. Ask the bot owner to enable it.
errors.summarizeNoAccess: You need View Channel and Read Message History in that channel to summarize it.
errors.nothingToSummarize: There's nothing recent to summarize in that channel.
errors.unavailable: The AI assistant isn't available right now — it may be disabled, or has no API key configured. An admin can check `/ai config view`.
errors.moderationUnavailable: The moderation plugin needs to be enabled for /mod-assist to look up case history.
errors.modAssistNeedsTarget: Provide either a case number or a user.
errors.caseNotFound: No case #{number} was found in this server.
errors.guildBudgetExhausted: This server's daily AI token budget has been used up. It resets at midnight UTC.
errors.userBudgetExhausted: You've used up your daily AI token allowance. It resets at midnight UTC.
errors.compatibleNeedsBaseUrl: The OpenAI-compatible provider needs a base URL.
errors.perUserBudgetExceedsDaily: The per-user budget can't be larger than the server-wide daily budget.
errors.emptyKey: The API key can't be empty.
